subject: The Tuesday night that saved their spark
preview_text: A couple was stuck in the same routine until one tap changed everything. Their story might be yours.
body_paragraphs: Last Tuesday, Mia and Jake sat on their couch scrolling through Netflix for the third time that week. They weren't arguing but something felt off. Jake said later it was like they were roommates who happened to share a bed. Then Mia opened SoulPlan without thinking and tapped 'cozy' on Tonight's Date.

Thirty seconds later, they were making hot chocolate and building a blanket fort in the living room. Jake told me it was the first time in months he felt seen. Not because of some grand gesture but because Mia had noticed the spark was fading and chose to do something about it. That night wasn't about the date itself. It was about the message it sent: I see you, I want us.

That's what Tonight's Date is built for. One tap on a mood and the AI picks a card tailor-made for your couple identity. Mia didn't have to plan or search. She just chose how she wanted to feel with Jake. And that single moment rewired their week. They started using the Memory Timeline to snap photos of their blanket fort and now they have a streak going.
Open SoulPlan tonight. Tap your mood on Tonight's Date. Let the app do the rest. P.S. The best part? Mia and Jake still talk about that blanket fort. Your story starts with one tap.
